_comment: Rename this file to appsettings.Production.json and replace <Placeholders> with actual values.
_comment_SslMode: Use SslMode=Required in production. The same connection string is parsed by TWO different drivers — MySql.Data (via EF Core) and MySqlConnector (the raw-ADO services) — and only Preferred, Required, VerifyCA and VerifyFull are valid for both. SslMode=None is accepted by MySqlConnector but rejected by MySql.Data, which makes every EF context fail to construct with "Requested value 'None' was not found". On a local development server with no TLS configured (XAMPP reports have_ssl=DISABLED), use SslMode=Preferred.
